sources.quote: 2 Ceti, also named Hydor, is a single star in the equatorial constellation of Cetus, near the border with Aquarius.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 4.2 solar radii and 3.04 solar masses (FLAME) and 9,823 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).
